'''Ordos Resources Qipanjing power station''' (鄂尔多斯资源集团高新材料公司棋盘井低热值煤电厂) is an operating power station of at least 660-megawatts (MW) in Qipanjing Town, Otog Front Banner, Ordos, Inner Mongolia, China.

==Background==

Construction for the Ordos Resources Qipanjing power station began in April 2013, with the plants beginning operation in 2015. The sponsoring company, Ordos High-Tech & New Material, was initially planning to build 4 units of 330,000 kilowatts. The first phase has been completed and is currently in operation; the second has yet to be proposed.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://www.tepc.ceec.net.cn/art/2015/10/14/art_8796_427292.html|title=内蒙古鄂尔多斯项目部1号机组168小时试运行|last=|first=|date=October 14, 2015|website=CEEC|url-status=live|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2021-05-27}}</ref>
